text:
maya: quick async q — onboarding pythia-7b-v2-quantized. who's got the canonical weights path and any tokenizer gotchas we should triage before canary? :eyes:

raj: weights are in gs://redwood-weights/pythia/7b/v2/q4/model.safetensors (confirmed). note: there's also a .meta.json next to it with vocab_size=50288.

sasha: tokenizer quirk: the upstream tokenizer for this checkpoint uses BOS=1 EOS=2, but our chat template code expects BOS=0. saw off-by-one in few-shot prompts.

maya: ugh. hmm. did that show up in the smoke eval?

ci-bot: tokenizer-smoke (pythia-7b-v2-q4): failure on prompt-format test 3 — mismatched token counts. logs: "expected 1 leading bos, got 0". see: https://ci.redwood.internal/ci/12345

raj: workaround: set tokenizer_config { "prepend_bos": true, "bos_token_id": 1, "eos_token_id": 2 } in the serving manifest. but need to validate we don't double-prepend for chat templates that already add system msg.

leo: quick snippet to reproduce locally:
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizers/pythia-7b-v2.json')
print(t.encode('Hello').ids)
```
I saw [1, 123, 456, 2] on my run (so BOS present).

anika: the model's kv-cache and position offset expects the BOS signal for certain positional kernels. if we strip BOS we might shift logits. better to normalize at input layer than change model weights.

maya: plan suggestion: 1) update serving manifest to explicitly set prepend_bos:true for this model variant, 2) add a prompt-normalizer in runtime to detect duplicated BOS when chat template already has a sentinel, 3) add a small canary route that fails open to fallback model if token mismatch persists.

raj: I can open the PR for manifest + unit test for tokenizer id. will add test that encodes: system+user and ensure only one leading bos.

sasha: can we also add an eval that compares generation continuity with and without explicit bos? quick BLEU-ish smoke: run 10 prompts and measure divergence.

maya: yes — add as a post-merge gating check. CI should run the 10 prompts against canary infra.

ci-bot: created ticket INF-7892 "pythia-7b-v2 tokenizer BOS mismatch" and linked to PR #4421. CI gating added.

leo: minor note: some downstream chat templates insert "
" before user message which the tokenizer may count differently; add a trimming step in prompt-normalizer to collapse leading whitespace/newlines.

anika: also flag for docs: call out model-specific tokenizer_config in model catalog UI so SRE/customers know to set prepend_bos on private deploys.

maya: action items:
- raj: PR for manifest + unit tests (ETA today EOD)
- sasha: small eval harness for BLEU-smoke (ETA tomorrow)
- leo: add prompt-normalizer prototype (ETA EOD)
- anika: update model catalog note (ETA tomorrow)

raj: pinging here when PR is up.

sasha: I'll coordinate with runtime to make the smoke run use canary route.

maya: thanks team — post here when PR and CI green, I'll kick the canary deploy. :thumbsup:

raj: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/serving/merge_requests/4421 — includes manifest + test.

ci-bot: CI pipeline passed for PR 4421 (unit tests & tokenizer-smoke).

maya: perfect. i'll schedule canary later today. leaving this thread open for any regressions. :white_check_mark:
